mapper.select: select count(*) from app_role where role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.insert: insert into app_role ( role_code, role_name, created_at ) values ( #{roleCode}, #{roleName}, current_timestamp )
mapper.select: select ar.role_code from app_user_role aur join app_role ar on ar.role_id = aur.role_id where aur.user_id = #{userId} order by ar.role_code
mapper.insert: insert into app_user_role ( user_id, role_id, created_at ) select #{userId}, ar.role_id, current_timestamp from app_role ar where ar.role_code = #{roleCode}
